transform.sql: WITH POOL_DP_VOL_CAP AS( SELECT PD_PLC.DATETIME, PD_PLC.POOL_ID, CAST(SUM(PD_VVC.USED_CAPACITY) / 1024 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS USED_CAPACITY FROM PD_PLC JOIN PD_VVC ON PD_PLC.COLLECTION_TIME = PD_VVC.COLLECTION_TIME AND PD_PLC.POOL_ID = PD_VVC.POOL_ID GROUP BY PD_PLC.DATETIME, PD_PLC.POOL_ID) SELECT PD_PLC.DATETIME, PD_PLC.POOL_ID, CASE WHEN PD_PLC.POOL_NAME IS NULL THEN PD_PLC.POOL_ID ELSE PD_PLC.POOL_NAME END AS NULL_IGNORED_POOL_NAME, CONCAT( CASE WHEN PD_PLC.POOL_NAME IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE PD_PLC.POOL_NAME END, '(', PD_PLC.POOL_ID, ')' ) AS POOL_DISPLAY_NAME, PD_PLC.PHYSICAL_CAPACITY_TOTAL, PD_PLC.PHYSICAL_CAPACITY_FREE, PD_PLC.PHYSICAL_CAPACITY_USED, PD_PLC.PHYSICAL_CAPACITY_USAGE_RATE, PD_PLC.TOTAL_MANAGED_CAPACITY, PD_PLC.TOTAL_ACTUAL_CAPACITY AS LOGICAL_CAPACITY_TOTAL, PD_PLC.FREE_CAPACITY AS LOGICAL_CAPACITY_FREE, PD_PLC.USED_CAPACITY AS LOGICAL_CAPACITY_USED, PD_PLC.USAGE_RATE AS LOGICAL_CAPACITY_USAGE_RATE, CASE WHEN PD_PLC.ATTRIBUTE LIKE '%(Tiering)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TIER_ENABLE, CASE WHEN PD_PLC.DKC_SAVING_CAPACITY > 0 THEN PD_PLC.DKC_SAVING_CAPACITY ELSE null END AS DKC_SAVING_CAPACITY, CASE WHEN PD_PLC.FMC_POOL_CAPACITY_SAVING > 0 THEN PD_PLC.FMC_POOL_CAPACITY_SAVING ELSE null END AS FMC_POOL_CAPACITY_SAVING, CASE WHEN PD_PLC.SAVING_CAPACITY > 0 THEN PD_PLC.SAVING_CAPACITY ELSE null END AS SAVING_CAPACITY, CASE WHEN PD_PLC.DATA_VOLUME_USED_CAPACITY >= 0 THEN PD_PLC.DATA_VOLUME_USED_CAPACITY ELSE POOL_DP_VOL_CAP.USED_CAPACITY END AS DATA_VOLUME_USED_CAPACITY, CASE WHEN PD_PLC.AUTO_EXPANSION = 'Enable' THEN 1 WHEN PD_PLC.AUTO_EXPANSION = 'Disable' THEN 0 ELSE -1 END AS AUTO_EXPANSION, CASE WHEN PD_PEFF.TOTAL_EFFICIENCY_RATIO >= 0 THEN PD_PEFF.TOTAL_EFFICIENCY_RATIO ELSE null END AS TOTAL_EFFICIENCY_RATIO FROM PD_PLC LEFT OUTER JOIN PD_PEFF ON PD_PLC.COLLECTION_TIME = PD_PEFF.COLLECTION_TIME AND PD_PLC.POOL_ID = PD_PEFF.POOL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN POOL_DP_VOL_CAP ON PD_PLC.DATETIME = POOL_DP_VOL_CAP.DATETIME AND PD_PLC.POOL_ID = POOL_DP_VOL_CAP.POOL_ID;
